freeze_scope: Local protocol and source hashes frozen before first performance run; not externally preregistered

scenario_definitions.mean_shift: After episode64: practice +6 items, work -4 items, on top of original noise
scenario_definitions.noise_shift: After episode64: extra Gaussian(0,4) items, fixed RNG seed+30000
scenario_definitions.gradual_shift: Mean shift linearly from 1/32 to full magnitude over episodes64..95, then fixed
scenario_definitions.return_shift: Mean shift only episodes64..95, then return to original generator
scenario_definitions.delayed_mean_shift: Mean shift with 7-day label delay on every fifth episode
scenario_definitions.irregular_delayed_mean_shift: Mean shift + same delay; starts separated by repeating [2,3,5,2,4] days and an extra40-day gap before episode64; no overlapping outcome windows

selection_reason: Single approximate-month calendar heuristic, not chosen by benchmark performance; no sweep
likelihood: Original fixed prior times product of Gaussian likelihoods raised to 2**(-(as_of-ended_at)/32days); original observation noise model and Student-t marginal
support: All original gates plus weight_mass>=min_samples and exact-portfolio weight_mass>=min_portfolio_samples. Report weight concentration ESS separately; it is not independent sample size or a support substitute.
comparison: Issue forecasts at episode started_at using only labels recorded by that time. Never score diagnostic numbers on abstentions. Paired scores share exactly the supported episode IDs; fixed-schedule finite rate reported separately. Summary improvement cannot override any failed cell.
evaluation_limit: Synthetic generator already known and deliberately close to linear feature family. New seeds reduce reuse of previous outcomes; they do not make an independent personal benchmark. No power analysis or confidence/coverage guarantee.
adoption: Necessary gates only. Research module excluded from runtime; keep default unchanged even if synthetic gates pass until external/future-data validation exists.
tuning: No half-life/seed/scenario/support/threshold changes after observing benchmark. Any change requires v2; retain failed results.
